summary: Nano-X Imaging Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its proxy statement and proxy card for the 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for September 17, 2026. The agenda includes re-electing two Class III directors, approving an increase in authorized share capital by 50,000,000 ordinary shares, approving two equity grants to CEO Erez Meltzer, and re-appointing Kesselman Kesselman as independent auditors. This is a routine annual meeting notice with no special-situation elements such as mergers, tender offers, or strategic changes. The record date is August 18, 2026. The filing is ordinary for a foreign private issuer and does not indicate any corporate action that would classify it as a special situation.
